Class PositionState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.PositionState
class PositionState extends GameState

Represents the state of the game where players are placing their totems on the board. In this state, players can place their totems on available track cards, and the game will handle the placement logic, including checking for valid positions, applying effects, and transitioning to the next state when all players have placed their totems.

      Moves player p from the TurnOrderCard towards the required TrackCard, if it is possible to do so.

      context - the game context where the action is performed (must not be null)
